verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev is a workflow/background-job platform, so event triggers from connected apps are a fair question. The evidence only documents triggering tasks from your own backend code (`task.trigger()`) and cron schedules; it shows no built-in triggers for new records, messages, emails or form submissions in connected apps. Programmatic triggering from your own code is a developer building block, not this capability.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can trigger workflows from events in connected apps (new record, message, email, form submission)
